name: git-scm
description: Built-in VS Code-style Source Control panel: stage, commit, amend, push/pull/fetch, branch switching, stash, commit history, and diff view (bundled — see extensions/build.mjs).

gitScm.pollInterval.description: How often (ms) to poll the active directory's git status, kept running in the background so the sidebar badge stays current even when the SOURCE CONTROL panel isn't open. 0 disables polling — status only refreshes on the refresh button, active-directory change, and after an operation.

gitScm.fetchInterval.description: How often (ms) to run a non-interactive `git fetch` in the background so ahead/behind counts stay current without manually pulling. 0 (default) disables background fetch. A non-zero value below 60000 is treated as 60000. Never prompts for credentials — a repo whose remote needs auth just fails the fetch silently; use Pull or the More Actions menu's Fetch entry for an interactive attempt.

gitScm.fileTreeDecorations.description: Show git status badges and row colors in the FILES tree (the branch pill stays either way). Off skips the per-repo status scan — the expensive part on large repos.

gitScm.clickAction.description: What clicking a file in the SOURCE CONTROL panel opens. Shift+click always opens the other one.
